methodology.summary: Uranium miners, nuclear services and utilities with nuclear exposure, ranked with growth and technical evidence where available.
paragraphs: Nuclear Energy Renaissance is constructed only from the existing Stockmonk US coverage universe. Intended investment horizon: 3-5 years. Every selected company passed the strategy's sector, size, liquidity and score-coverage screens.

Eligible US-listed companies are ranked with the Stockmonk four-factor scores: Growth 25% · Quality 25% · Valuation 20% · Technical 30%. Uranium miners, nuclear services and utilities with nuclear exposure, ranked with growth and technical evidence where available. Theme membership is a curated list of 16 US-listed companies with direct exposure to the theme. The engine verifies every selected ticker against the coverage universe and does not fill the basket with unrelated sector names. The highest-ranked names are selected subject to a 13% single-stock cap and a 80% sector guide. Weights use score-proportional sizing. The portfolio is reviewed quarterly.

No ETF, mutual fund or non-US-listed security is eligible. Missing data is not filled with an estimate. A company without a full research report remains eligible only where the quantitative strategy calls for it, and its constituent card links to score evidence rather than a research report.
The performance shown is a current-constituent simulation, not a live track record. Rebalancing proposals are generated from the same rules and remain proposed until a future review is executed.
